svg.title: Authorization to release health information
svg.desc: Authorization to release health information Review template - not a guarantee of legal compliance or clinic acceptance. Confirm all entries and the receiving destination with the disclosing organization before use. Patient Name: Alex Rivera Date of birth: 1984-06-18 Address: 101 Patient Lane, Example City, CA 90001 Phone: 555-0101 Who may disclose Name: Example Clinic NPI: 1234567893 Address: 202 Clinic Road, Example City, CA 90002 Phone: 555-0102 Fax: 555-0103 Who may receive Care-team member Name: Recipient Clinic NPI: 1245319599 Address: 303 Recipient Street, Example City, CA 90003 Phone: 555-0104 Fax: 555-0105 Information to disclose [X] Full record (subject to exclusions below) [X] Date range: 2025-01-01 through 2026-10-22 [X] Visit notes [X] Labs [X] Imaging [X] Medications Only selected categories are requested. A selected date range limits the selected records. Full record does not override the sensitive-information review or psychotherapy-note exclusion. Sensitive information - separate review required [X] Mental health - Initials: AR [X] Substance use (42 CFR Part 2) - Initials: AR [X] HIV/STI - Initials: AR [X] Genetic - Initials: AR Sensitive categories require separate review before disclosure. Initials alone do not satisfy 42 CFR Part 2 or applicable state law; additional consent, statements, restrictions or forms may be required. Unselected sensitive categories are excluded, including from a full-record request. Psychotherapy notes are excluded from this authorization and require a separate authorization. Purpose At the request of the individual Expiration Expiration date: 2027-01-01 Your rights and important statements Release authorization template - Page 1 Right to revoke: You may revoke this authorization in writing at any time by delivering a written revocation to the disclosing person or organization at the address above. Revocation does not affect action already taken in reliance on this authorization. If authorization was obtained as a condition of insurance coverage, other law may permit the insurer to contest a claim or the policy. Confirm the discloser's revocation procedure before use. No conditioning: Treatment, payment, enrollment or eligibility for benefits generally may not be conditioned on signing this authorization. Exceptions permitted by law include research-related treatment, certain health-plan enrollment or eligibility determinations, and care provided solely to create information for a third party. If an exception applies, the discloser must explain the consequences of refusing before you sign. Potential for redisclosure: Information disclosed under this authorization may be redisclosed by the recipient and may no longer be protected by HIPAA. Other laws may still restrict use or redisclosure, including for substance use records. Right to a copy: You have the right to receive a copy of this signed authorization. Keep a copy for your records. Signature and date I authorize the discloser identified above to disclose the selected information to the identified recipient for the stated purpose until the stated expiration, subject to the exclusions and separate-review requirements above. Typed name: Alex Rivera Date supplied: 2026-10-22 Representative authority (if applicable): Not provided A typed name alone does not prove a valid electronic signature. This template does not verify identity, intent or signing authority. Complete the discloser's accepted signing process before use. Signature: ________________________________________ Date: ____________________ Release authorization template - Page 2
